statements.proposition: After this change, 'from crewai_tools import TavilySearchTool' no longer raises ImportError (it did at the base commit).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by static inspection of the import chain, not by running the import (no environment built; network installs in the sandbox were refused by the permission system for an earlier item, so I did not attempt them here). Base: neither crewai_tools/__init__.py nor crewai_tools/tools/__init__.py mentions Tavily, so the name is not importable from the package. Head: tools/__init__.py imports TavilySearchTool from its module, which defines the class and guards the optional 'tavily' dependency with try/except ImportError; crewai_tools/__init__.py re-exports it in its 'from .tools import (...)' block. PR is not merged; the claim is judged against the PR head.
